answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance is achieved via a token-based vault system. Each agent must deposit a unique token into a shared vault, with their stake proportional to their credibility. The vault's transparency, ensured by a decentralized lantern protocol, allows peers to validate token ownership. Sybil attackers, unable to fill the hollow of real resources without significant cost, risk losing all staked tokens upon detection, deterring large-scale deception.
